messages:
lina (support): Heads up — multiple customers reporting 503s and timeouts hitting /v1/generate since ~12:05UTC. Customers say requests return 503 within 2s. Escalating.

mika (oncall): @raj can you take a look at autoscaling? symptoms sound like scale-up lag.

raj (sre): Looking. I see a spike in gateway 503s from the hosted cluster at 12:04. Checking controller events and keda logs now.

infra-bot: Alert: gateway-503-rate spike on region-us-west-2; 120m requests with 15% 5xx (12:03:40 -> 12:04:20).

amanda (backend): We've just rotated a short-lived auth token for billing service at 12:02. Could be related if token refresh impacted provisioner calls.

raj (sre): kube events show ScaledObject/backfill-worker backoff: "failed to query external metric: 429 rate limited" repeated. KEDA is backing off for ~45s windows.

lina (support): repro steps from customer: curl -i https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" returns 503. They retried and succeeded after ~2m.

raj (sre): grabbing keda describe:
```
$ kubectl describe scaledobject backfill-worker -n hosted
Events:
  Type    Reason     Age   From               Message
  ----    ------     ----  ----               -------
  Normal  Triggered  2m    keda-operator       ScaledObject triggered scale up
  Warning Backoff    2m    keda-operator       External metrics query returned 429, backing off
```

mika (oncall): So KEDA couldn't fetch metrics due to auth/billing token rotation causing 429s from the metering endpoint? That would prevent HPA from seeing the queue metric and delay pods.

amanda (backend): Confirmed: the internal metrics proxy which KEDA queries validates billing tokens. During rotation we briefly returned 429 for token validation until caches warmed. I pushed a quick fallback in the proxy to serve cached responses for 30s.

raj (sre): I can see scale events resumed at 12:06. There was ~90s window with no new pods. Gateway queue length spiked -> 503s.

lina (support): Customer-facing impact: timeouts then success. They want a postmortem and mitigation.

mika (oncall): Immediate mitigation steps logged: (1) rollback token rollout if possible; (2) confirm proxy cache fallback deployed (amanda); (3) increase KEDA polling/failure tolerance temporarily.

amanda (backend): Cache fallback deployed at 12:07. Also added a retry for metrics endpoint which should prevent 429->backoff.

raj (sre): Repro steps for us:
1) simulate token rotate: POST /internal/auth/rotate (dev cluster)
2) observe keda metrics endpoint returning 429s
3) watch ScaledObject go into backoff and gateway 503 spike

Command snippets:
```
# simulate load
hey --concurrency 50 --requests 500 https://staging-api.redwood/v1/generate
# watch scaledobject
kubectl get events -n hosted --watch | grep ScaledObject
```

lina (support): I'll prepare a customer note: brief explanation + ETA for detailed postmortem.

mika (oncall): Follow-ups: raj to draft mitigation runbook (temporary KEDA tuning + probe to detect metrics proxy 429s), amanda to add graceful token-rollover behavior so validation endpoint doesn't return 429 during rollout, lina to coordinate customer comms.

raj (sre): Drafting runbook now, will push to /operations/incidents and ping here when ready.

amanda (backend): Opening a ticket to change token rotation to warm-swap mode and add caching/rate-limit shielding for metering endpoint.

mika (oncall): Nice work. We'll monitor for 30m. :thumbsup:
